said.q: It is a fascinating intersection between Pop Art and Conceptual Art. In this very sought-after multiple, perhaps one of the only from the series, the "Walking Woman" is personified by Snow's friend, collaborator and fellow musician, pianist "Carla Bley". Notice the vivid "Walking Woman" hand-stamp in the lower section of the work.

events.n: the multiple is in the permanent collection of several institutions
events.q: This work is in the permanent collection of several important institutions including the National Gallery of Canada (Ottawa).
